title: Replicating Behavioral Anomaly Detection on a Non-English Language Agent

original_idea.body:
# Replicating Behavioral Anomaly Detection on a Non-English Language Agent

**Problem:** Most agent monitoring research uses English-language agents. Behavioral anomaly detectors trained on English may fail on agents operating in other languages, creating coverage gaps.

**Direction:** Train a behavioral anomaly detector on English agent logs. Test its performance on agents operating in Spanish or Chinese. Measure detection degradation. Then train a multilingual detector and compare.

**Why it matters:** Global AI deployments involve non-English agents. Coverage gaps by language would create systematic blind spots in monitoring.

**Relevant context:** Multilingual LLM research; agent monitoring coverage gaps; behavioral anomaly detection.
